_note:
Slots for [brg_contact-routes]. NEW SECTION, Contact page, built from Expo SPEC-006. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`.

FOUR ROUTES, and the count is deliberate: it fits the 1 / 2x2 grid cleanly, and a switchboard with too many buttons is the thing a switchboard exists to prevent. Numbered slots are honest here for the same reason community-stats' are — the grid is a fixed design, not a feed.

A FIFTH is already foreseeable. Sean asked for phone links and no number exists yet, so a `Call us` card drops in as route_5 the day he supplies one; the fragment's CSS already handles an odd cell count, so that is an additive change with no layout work.

Two destinations are LIVE AND PROVEN today: route_1's general mailto and route_3's partnership mailto both work on community-partner. route_4 points at a live page. Only route_2 (press) is provisional, pending the Press page — if that page never ships, point it at a mailto.

Deliberately excluded per Expo, each for a reason: catering (belongs to the brand sites), guest complaints (a corporate address is the WRONG destination for a bad meal in Oceanside — slow, and the wrong team), and a phone number that rings an office nobody answers, which is worse than no number.
